metadata.question: Was the aerosol optical depth higher over the Takalaman Desert in February 2020 than in February 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search Strategy: Use MODIS aerosol product (MODIS/061/MCD19A2_GRANULES) for AOD at 550nm. Filter for February 2019 and February 2020 over Taklamakan Desert region. 2. Masking Strategy: Need to mask clouds/quality issues. MODIS aerosol products have quality flags - I'll use the mandatory quality flag to filter out poor quality retrievals. 3. Logic: Compare mean AOD values between 2019 and 2020. Need to check for valid data in both periods, ensure sufficient pixel counts, and validate the calculated values are reasonable (AOD typically ranges 0-3). Let me define the Taklamakan Desert region and use MODIS MCD19A2 which provides Multi-Angle Implementation of Atmospheric Correction (MAIAC) AOD data. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry - Taklamakan Desert region const taklamakan = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[78.0, 41.0], [88.0, 41.0], [88.0, 37.0], [78.0, 37.0], [78.0, 41.0]] ]); // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS MAIAC AOD const getAOD = function(year) { const startDate = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 2, 1); const endDate = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 3, 1); return ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MCD19A2_GRANULES') .filterBounds(taklamakan) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select(['Optical_Depth_055', 'AOD_QA']) .map(function(image) { // Mask poor quality pixels (bit 0-1: 0=best, 1=good, 2=marginal, 3=bad) const qa = image.select('AOD_QA'); const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(3).lte(2); // Keep best, good, marginal return image.select('Optical_Depth_055').updateMask(mask).multiply(0.001); // Scale factor }); }; const aod2019 = getAOD(2019); const aod2020 = getAOD(2020); // Check collection sizes const count2019 = aod2019.size().getInfo(); const count2020 = aod2020.size().getInfo(); print(`2019 Images: ${count2019}, 2020 Images: ${count2020}`); if (count2019 === 0 || count2020 === 0) { print("C1"); return; } // Create mean composites and calculate statistics const mean2019 = aod2019.mean(); const mean2020 = aod2020.mean(); const stats2019 = mean2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: taklamakan, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2020 = mean2020.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: taklamakan, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const meanAOD2019 = stats2019.Optical_Depth_055; const meanAOD2020 = stats2020.Optical_Depth_055; const pixels2019 = stats2019.Optical_Depth_055_count; const pixels2020 = stats2020.Optical_Depth_055_count; print(`2019 Mean AOD: ${meanAOD2019?.toFixed(4)}, Pixels: ${pixels2019}`); print(`2020 Mean AOD: ${meanAOD2020?.toFixed(4)}, Pixels: ${pixels2020}`); // Validation checks if (pixels2019 === 0 || pixels2020 === 0) { print("C2"); return; } if (meanAOD2019 === null || meanAOD2020 === null || isNaN(meanAOD2019) || isNaN(meanAOD2020) || meanAOD2019 < 0 || meanAOD2019 > 3 || meanAOD2020 < 0 || meanAOD2020 > 3) { print("C3"); return; } // Final comparison if (meanAOD2020 > meanAOD2019) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
